This page lists 41 iTerm2 keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `iterm2.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in iTerm2 to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t iterm2.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/iterm2.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/iTerm.app`; if iTerm2 lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Tabs & Windows

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘T` | New Tab |
| `⌘W` | Close Tab or Window |
| `⌘1-9` | Go to Tab by number |
| `⌥⌘←→↑↓` | Go to Split Pane by Direction |
| `` ⌘` `` | Cycle iTerm Windows |

## Splitting

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘D` | Split Window Vertically |
| `⇧⌘D` | Split Window Horizontally |
| `⌥⌘H` | Split Horizontally (new profile) |
| `⌥⌘V` | Split Vertically (new profile) |

## Pane Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘]` | Next Split Pane |
| `⌘[` | Previous Split Pane |
| `⌥⌘↑` | Focus Pane Up |
| `⌥⌘↓` | Focus Pane Down |
| `⌥⌘←` | Focus Pane Left |
| `⌥⌘→` | Focus Pane Right |

## Fullscreen & Resize

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⏎` | Toggle Fullscreen |
| `⇧⌘⏎` | Maximize Pane |
| `⌃⌘↑↓←→` | Resize Pane |

## Tab Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘←` | Previous Tab |
| `⌘→` | Next Tab |
| `⌥⌘1-9` | Go to Window by number |

## Copy & Paste

Enable "Copy to pasteboard on selection" for auto-copy.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘C` | Enter Copy Mode |
| `⌃V` | Enter Character Selection (in Copy Mode) |
| `HJKL` | Move cursor (in Copy Mode) |
| `⌃K` | Copy text (in Copy Mode) |

## Shell Shortcuts

These work in bash/zsh/fish.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃U` | Delete to start of line |
| `⌃K` | Delete to end of line |
| `⌃W` | Delete previous word |
| `⌃A` | Move to start of line |
| `⌃E` | Move to end of line |
| `⌥←` | Move back one word |
| `⌥→` | Move forward one word |
| `⌃L` | Clear screen |
| `⌃D` | Exit shell (EOF) |
| `⌃R` | Search command history |
| `⌃G` | Cancel search |
| `⌃Y` | End search at current entry |

## Misc

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘K` | Clear screen/pane |
| `⌥⌘I` | Broadcast to all panes (toggle) |
| `⌘/` | Find Cursor |
| `⌥+click` | Cursor jump with mouse |

## Template file

The full [`iterm2.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/iterm2.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
